user.title: Atios SmartCore (advanced)
user.description: This sets up direct raw-DALI access to the SmartCore. For everyday light control, most users should instead pair the SmartCore via Matter (DALI Configurator → Accessory Manager → Matter). Use this integration for raw DALI, scenes, the bus monitor, firmware updates and the web-UI panel. Enter the SmartCore IP address or hostname.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SmartCore at that address.

init.title: Atios SmartCore options
init.description: Mode: 'basic' exposes named per-address lights and firmware only — use the Matter pairing for the full curated model. 'advanced' also exposes the bus-wide broadcast light and other raw-DALI features. The web panel shows the SmartCore UI in the sidebar; note an http:// URL will not embed inside an https:// Home Assistant, and the SmartCore must not send X-Frame-Options: DENY.
